_comment: Curation overrides for build/generate.mjs, keyed by repository name. Anything set here wins over the GitHub API. Use it only where the auto-derived value is genuinely wrong or ambiguous — every repo NOT listed here is fully automatic, which is the point.

fuuz-vscode-extension.title: Fuuz for VS Code
fuuz-vscode-extension.summary: Connect VS Code to a Fuuz environment over MCP: resources, ERDs, flows, data queries, installable platform skills, and UI validation in a real browser.

fuuz-dev-console.title: Fuuz Dev Console
fuuz-dev-console.summary: A Chrome DevTools extension that reads a Fuuz screen's console as an execution log beside the state it produced, with trace links between the two.

fuuz-agentic-workflows.title: Agentic Workflows
fuuz-agentic-workflows.summary: Working MCP tools built as Fuuz data flows — seven live tools an agent can call to read a tenant's models, flows and screens, plus the chat interface that drives them.
